subject: Private Offer -> Marketplace migration: term extension, regional burst & invoice split
messages:
From: Tom Evans <tevans@goodcare.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, procurements@goodcare.com
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft PO & ask: migrate private offer to AWS Marketplace, extend term + regional burst

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, GoodCare wants to shift our current AWS Private Offer onto the AWS Marketplace to consolidate billing and enable our regional burst capacity in eu-west-1 later this year. We also want to extend the term from 12 -> 18 months so that the overall commit stays aligned with our fiscal plan.

Attached is the draft PO your team prepared (GoodCare_AWS_PO_Draft_0507.pdf). Key asks from procurement:
- Confirm Marketplace billing split (we prefer a 60/40 invoice tranche across two invoices).
- Add a formal clause for regional burst (up to +30% in eu-west-1 for the first 3 months) and how that will be invoiced.
- Need an acceptance window & SLA mapping so our operations can plan the cutover.

Can Redwood confirm whether the Private Offer can be transitioned without losing current pricing tiers and whether any SLA exceptions are needed for the regional burst? Also looping in legal for any redlines.

Best,
Tom Evans
Director, Cloud Procurement
GoodCare Health

Attachment: GoodCare_AWS_PO_Draft_0507.pdf (application/pdf, 234 KB)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Tom Evans <tevans@goodcare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft PO & ask: migrate private offer to AWS Marketplace, extend term + regional burst

Tom — thanks for laying this out and for the PO. We can absolutely support a Marketplace transition and the term extension, and we have a recommended plan:

1) Legal redline of the PO (Marissa will lead) — we should have a redline within 48 hours.
2) Billing cadence proposal (Ben) — propose two-tranche invoice schedule (60/40) with clear invoice triggers.
3) Marketplace acceptance & activation window (Neha) — we need to confirm AWS acceptance timelines; typical cutover is 10 business days but eur burst may require a short lead.
4) Runbook & handoff — we’ll provide a short ops runbook and a 1-week ramp for the regional burst.

Ben / Neha / Marissa — can you confirm your availability to turn these around? Tom — I’ll share the internal timelines once we have Ben/Neha input.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Stephanie Nguyen
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Tom Evans <tevans@goodcare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft PO & ask: migrate private offer to AWS Marketplace, extend term + regional burst

Stephanie / Tom — quick notes on billing:
- We can accept a 60/40 split (Invoice A at activation covering 60% of committed dollars; Invoice B billed 90 days after activation covering remaining 40%).
- For the regional burst (eu-west-1), we propose treating burst usage as billed monthly as overage tied to metered usage; for the first 3 months, Redwood will apply a capped uplift invoice not to exceed 30% of committed monthly ARR.
- AWS Marketplace settlement may require up to an additional 7 business days for final reconciliation; we’ll flag that on the invoice terms.

Marissa — please include a clause about invoice timing for marketplace settlement in the redline.

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: GoodCare Legal <legal@goodcare.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Evans <tevans@goodcare.com>, procurements@goodcare.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft PO & ask: migrate private offer to AWS Marketplace, extend term + regional burst

Hi Stephanie / Ben — attaching our redline to your draft PO (GoodCare_PO_redline_0510.pdf). A few requested edits:
- Replace the term extension language with explicit automatic renewal language and a 90-day termination notice.
- Add indemnity carveouts for regional data residency during burst (we need confirmation on where KV caches are held for eu-west-1 bursts).
- EU VAT: since part of the usage will be billed in eu-west-1, GoodCare will need a VAT invoice for our tax team. Please confirm Redwood’s VAT handling for marketplace invoices.

We’re aiming to get a signed amendment prior to the marketplace conversion. Can you confirm if Redwood can provide a VAT-capable invoice and the requested residency guarantees?

Regards,
Lori Chen
Senior Counsel, GoodCare Health

Attachment: GoodCare_PO_redline_0510.pdf (application/pdf, 98 KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: GoodCare Legal <legal@goodcare.com>, Tom Evans <tevans@goodcare.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft PO & ask: migrate private offer to AWS Marketplace, extend term + regional burst

Lori / Tom — thanks for the redline. A few operational clarifications and proposed timeline:

- VAT & billing: Redwood can issue VAT-capable invoices via the AWS Marketplace settlement process. Ben and I will confirm the VAT fields captured; we’ll provide an exported invoice sample.
- Data residency for burst: our runtime will spin additional capacity in eu-west-1. KV caches for in-flight requests are ephemeral and can be configured to remain in-region during burst; I’ll have our infra team confirm configuration and provide a short statement for the PO.
- Proposed timeline:
  * Day 0: Signed amendment via DocuSign (link below).
  * Day 1–3: Marketplace acceptance paperwork submitted.
  * Day 7–14: Activation and regional burst enabled (soft ramp).

Please review and, if okay, sign the amendment here: https://www.docusign.com/en/signature-request/ABCDEF123456

We’ll also attach a 1-week ops runbook and schedule a 30-minute handoff call after activation.

Neha Kapoor
Product Partnerships & Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: ops_runbook_marketplace_cutover_v1.md (text/markdown, 12 KB)

From: Tom Evans <tevans@goodcare.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurements@goodcare.com, GoodCare Legal <legal@goodcare.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft PO & ask: migrate private offer to AWS Marketplace, extend term + regional burst

Neha / Stephanie — sounds good. I reviewed Ben’s invoice proposal and Lori’s redline; GoodCare will:
- Accept the 60/40 invoice split as long as we receive a VAT-capable Invoice for the eu-west-1 uplift.
- Agree to the 18-month term with automatic renewal language per Lori’s redline.
- Approve the regional burst plan and the 3-month capped uplift.

I signed the amendment via DocuSign and attached the signed copy (signed_docusign_renewal_0513.pdf). Please confirm receipt and share the ops runbook + proposed handoff time. We’ll target activation week of May 24 (one-week ramp).

Thanks all — Tom

Attachment: signed_docusign_renewal_0513.pdf (application/pdf, 56 KB)
